test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Pig in a poke

options.text: To bring something to an end
A brave man amongst all the cowards
Something that is bought without examining properly

solution: The **correct answer** is 'Option 3' i.e. **'Something that is bought without examining properly'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom** "Pig in a poke"** refers to buying or accepting something without first inspecting it or knowing its value, akin to buying a pig concealed in a bag (poke) without seeing it first.(बगैर ठीक से जांचे सामान को ख़रीदना) • **For example:** "He bought the car online and it turned out to be a pig in a poke - it had numerous mechanical issues." • The correct meaning "Something that is bought without examining properly" aligns with this concept. It refers to purchasing or acquiring something without a thorough inspection(बिना ठीक से जांचे वस्तु को ख़रीदना) • **For example:** "Buying a house without a proper inspection can turn out to be a situation of buying something that is bought without examining properly." Therefore, the **correct answer** is- 'Option 3' i.e**. 'Something that is bought without examining properly'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Option 1 **'To bring something to an end' signifies finalizing or concluding a matter or situation.(किसी चीज़ को अंत करना) • **Idiom- "Put the sunset on the day"** suggests the act of concluding or finalizing something, akin to the sun setting, which represents the end of the day. • **Option 2** 'A brave man amongst all the cowards' signifies a person who shows courage even when everyone else around them is scared. (डरपोकों के बीच एक बहादुर आदमी) • **Idiom**- **"A lion among sheep"** signifies a brave person standing out amongst the crowd of those who are fearful. • **Option 4** 'To obstruct someone's work' implies creating hurdles or interruptions in someone else's tasks.(किसी के काम में बाधा डालना) • **Idiom**-** "Throwing rocks in the gears"** indicates deliberate sabotage or hindrance to someone's tasks or processes similar to how throwing rocks in mechanical gears would halt their operation. 43:T6e5, The correct answer is **Saint.**
